# governance

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for an actual shared design-system change. Identify consumers,
compatibility, replacements, and existing release/versioning conventions.
Do not add SemVer/changelog bureaucracy to ordinary app CSS edits.
Record material decisions in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md or existing package docs.
Give migration/deprecation windows where real consumers need them.
